description: Screen England & Wales postcode districts by region and median property price. Returns matching districts with medians and links, cheapest first. Use for questions like "areas in the North West under £250k". The region must be one of: North East, North West, Yorkshire and The Humber, East Midlands, West Midlands, East of England, London, South East, South West, Wales. Counties and cities are not regions (Kent and Surrey are in South East); for a town or borough use `search`. Districts with fewer than 30 sales in the last 12 months are left out. Scotland is not covered.

max_median_price_gbp.description: Maximum 12m median sold price in GBP, as a plain number such as 250000 (optional)

region.description: One region name from the list in the tool description, e.g. "North West", "London", "South East" (optional)

name: search_areas
title: Screen districts by price and region
